name: Türkiye Vakiflar Bankasi Türk Anonim Ortakligi
summary: Türkiye Vakiflar Bankasi Türk Anonim Ortakligi, together with its subsidiaries, provides corporate, commercial, SME, agricultural, and modern banking products and services in Turkey and internationally. It offers time, demand, and term deposits accounts; mortgage, car, personal, and private banking yacht loans; housing, comprehensive, motor, compulsory traffic, travel and complementary health, and compulsory earthquake insurance; and individual pension contract, private pension agreement, and life insurance products.
